_help: THE voices for every @maddiee.makess reel (Option 3 (American teen Maddie + young British Claude), re-chosen 2026-11-11). Never change the refs: every line is cloned from them so Maddie and Claude always sound the same. Per reel: copy this file to studio/voices/<scene>.json, fill 'jobs' (one per line, emotion tags like [sigh] [laughter] [surprise-oh] [surprise-wa] [question-en] [dissatisfaction-hnn] go inside the text), run the 'voices (OmniVoice)' workflow with that config, then put the wavs in codevid/voice/<scene>/NN.wav (render.js uses them automatically).

jobs.text: [question-en] Hey Claude... everyone's talking about Nvidia's CEO. What actually happened?
In two weeks... the man who led Nvidia for thirty-three years... lost his job.
October twenty-ninth... The New York Times reported his relationship with a woman described as an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
November eighth... He emailed all Nvidia staff, admitted an affair, and apologised... The board opened an investigation.
Then reports came out of a second affair... with an Nvidia employee.
November twelfth... He resigned as CEO, president, and from the board... Effective immediately.
[question-en] Did he give China any secrets?
That's not proven... The board says it has no reason to believe national security was compromised.
Congress wants him to testify on December first.
It fell over fourteen percent... at one point on the day he resigned.
[question-en] So who's running Nvidia right now?
CFO Colette Kress... as interim CEO.
Prediction markets favour Ian Buck... the Nvidia engineer behind CUDA.
Also named... Apple's Johny Srouji... Arm's Rene Haas... Tim Cook... and Nikesh Arora, an Indian-origin CEO.
Whoever gets it... has the hardest job in tech.
Replacing someone who ran it for thirty-three years?... Yes.
